flags: WATERFRONT: lakefront -> lakeview proposed (down by default). The stored evidence ('RVs parked directly on the shoreline benches at the waterline') describes campers on the exposed lakebed of a drawn-down reservoir: 3DEP puts those spots and the stored pin at 231-233.5 m against a 780-ft spillway crest (~238.5 m NAVD88), i.e. under water at full pool. Measured to the high-water line instead: the paved loop at 35.8653,-120.9749 ends 60-80 m from the 238.5 m contour and 3+ m above it; the west-peninsula loop (restroom building, RVs on pads) has its lowest occupied pad ~4 m above full pool and ~16 m from it down a ~12-14 degree slope (pad 35.85889,-120.96987) - the closest call, but the county's loop maps (B, J, K) could not be read, so no site numbers can be named and no site can be shown to be sold nightly within ~50 m of the high-water edge on open, gentle ground. Every loop has an open sightline over the lake. Suggested evidence: 'Full pool 780 ft (~238.5 m); developed loops 241-247 m: paved loop 60-80 m from the high-water line, west-peninsula loop ~16 m and ~4 m above at its lowest pad (35.85889,-120.96987); lakebed camping below the high-water line does not count; loop maps unread (403). Esri + 3DEP, read 2026-11-27.'

PIN MOVE ~730 m (suggested): stored 35.8620,-120.9769 is on the exposed lakebed at the tip of a finger (231 m, under water at full pool). Suggest 35.8590,-120.9697 (the west-peninsula loop with the restroom building and occupied pads); the paved loop at 35.8653,-120.9749 (~400 m from the stored pin) is the alternative. Which of these is the B, J or K loop is unknown (maps unread), so AWH may prefer the North Shore entrance area.
